visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle fade-in and slide-up on scroll using framer-motion. No complex 3D or heavy motion. Smooth button hover states (color transitions).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Sticky header MUST use bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md. No fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle borders (border-[#E5E5E0]) for cards, combined with subtle shadows.

sections.name: Header
sections.details: Sticky header (z-50), bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md, border-b border-gray-100. Logo text 'Groen & Buiten Hoveniers'. Links: Diensten, Over ons, Projecten, Reviews, Contact. CTA button 'Offerte aanvragen'. Mobile hamburger menu.

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Large background tuinfoto (h-[80vh] or min-h-[600px]). Overlay: bg-black/40 (ensure text readability). Headline: 'Uw tuin, professioneel aangelegd en onderhouden.' in white. Dual CTA: Primary ('Offerte aanvragen') in primary green, Secondary ('Onze diensten') as white outline button.

sections.name: USP Bar
sections.details: Placed just below or overlapping hero. 4 items grid (1 col mobile, 2 tablet, 4 desktop). Background: surface_secondary (#F0F0EA). Icons using lucide-react (e.g., Leaf, ShieldCheck, ThumbsUp, Clock) in primary green. Titles like 'Vakkundig', 'Persoonlijk', 'Duurzaam', 'Betrouwbaar'.

sections.name: Diensten (Services)
sections.details: Section title 'Van ontwerp tot onderhoud'. Grid of 4 cards (1 col mobile, 2 col desktop). Each card has a photo at the top (aspect-video, rounded-t-2xl), title, short description, and subtle 'Lees meer' link. Cards have white bg, subtle shadow, and rounded-2xl.

sections.name: Over ons (About us)
sections.details: 2-column layout. Left: high-quality image of landscaper at work (rounded-2xl). Right: Text 'Over ons', heading 'Uw lokale expert in groen', compact paragraphs about passion and reliability.

sections.name: Projecten (Portfolio)
sections.details: Section title 'Onze Projecten'. Asymmetric bento grid of 3 large images. 1 large image on the left spanning 2 rows, 2 smaller images stacked on the right. All images rounded-2xl with object-cover.

sections.name: Reviews
sections.details: Section title 'Wat onze klanten zeggen'. 3 testimonial cards in a 3-col grid. White bg, subtle shadow, quote icon, short text, customer name and location (e.g., 'Amsterdam').

sections.name: CTA Section
sections.details: Banner style. Background: surface_secondary (#F0F0EA). Heading 'Ook plannen voor uw tuin?'. Includes a clear call option with phone icon and a primary button.

sections.name: Contact
sections.details: 2-column layout. Left: Contact details (Address, Phone, Email) with lucide icons. Right: Contact form using Shadcn UI (Name, Email, Phone, Message, Submit button). Form inputs should have rounded-lg.

sections.name: Footer
sections.details: Background primary green (#1E3F20), white text. Logo text, quick links, copyright. Subtle 'DEMO WEBSITE' text with opacity 50% marking.

component_instructions.buttons: Primary button: bg-[#1E3F20] text-white hover:bg-[#142A15] transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-3. Secondary button: bg-white/10 text-white border border-white hover:bg-white hover:text-[#1E3F20] (for hero) or bg-white text-[#1E3F20] border border-[#1E3F20] hover:bg-[#F0F0EA] (for light sections).
component_instructions.inputs: Use standard Shadcn UI inputs but customize with rounded-lg, border-[#E5E5E0], focus-visible:ring-[#1E3F20].
component_instructions.cards: Use standard HTML/Tailwind divs instead of Shadcn Card component for marketing sections to allow more layout flexibility, unless it's a simple review card.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
Use APCA contrast rules. Ensure high contrast for text. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text (like a transparent header).
Use framer-motion for scroll reveal animations (e.g., fade up, stagger children). Keep it subtle and professional.
Avoid generic centered text layouts unless it's a short hero headline or section title. Left-align dense content.
Do not use 'transition: all' in CSS. Specify transition properties.
Ensure generous spacing: use py-16 to py-32 for section padding.
Make sure to load 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts via Google Fonts in the HTML or global CSS.
